entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Unbelievable. I need to make a simple return and your website is a joke! I'm about to lose my mind!
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana, and you've reached VeloFit support. I'm sorry to hear you're having a frustrating experience.
Frustrating doesn't even cover it! I want to return this helmet I bought, and I want to do it now. If I get any kind of runaround, I'm lighting you up on every review site on the internet.

I understand your urgency, and I can definitely look into this return for you. To start, can you tell me what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
It's the wrong damn color! It was supposed to be a gift, but it's hideous. The box is unopened, it's pristine. Just process the return. This isn't rocket science.
I see. Thank you for clarifying. I can certainly help with that. Could I please get your order number?
Fine. It's VF-98112. And don't waste my time. If this call takes more than five minutes, I want your manager's name and direct line.
Thank you. Let me just pull up order VF-98112... Okay, I see the order for the Apex Trail helmet, delivered 45 days ago.
And? Are you going to tell me it's too late now? I knew it! This is exactly the garbage I was expecting!

Not at all, sir. You are well within our 90-day return window. Your safety and satisfaction are our top priorities, and we want to make sure you have gear you're happy with. Since the box is unopened, this will be a very straightforward process.
Wait, really? You're just... approving it? No fight?

That's correct. There's no need for a fight. I've just initiated the return for you. A pre-paid shipping label has been sent to the email address on file. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and you can drop it off at any post office. You'll receive a full refund once it arrives back at our warehouse.
Oh. Well... that was... surprisingly easy. Thank you, Diana. I apologize for my tone earlier.
No apology necessary. I'm glad I could resolve this for you quickly. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
